purpose: Which artifact directory is authoritative for which claim, so a future reader never has to guess which of several similarly-named directories to cite.

authoritative_directories.authoritative_for: CARE_NARROW vs CARE_SEMANTIC feature-policy comparison (all 3 farms, isolation_forest + zscore_threshold); the feature inventory (per-farm raw-column classification); the A->B/A->C cross-farm transfer re-check under CARE_SEMANTIC.
authoritative_directories.owner_session: this session (Claude / CLI), Gate 5.4 - CARE Fidelity Audit + RAI Integration

authoritative_directories.authoritative_for: The six directed cross-farm transfers (A<->B, A<->C, B<->C) under RAIChampionDetector, all 3 conditions (FROZEN_SOURCE, TARGET_NORMAL_CALIBRATED, TARGET_SPECIFIC_REFERENCE), turbine-clustered bootstrap CIs, distribution-shift diagnostics.
authoritative_directories.owner_session: the concurrently-running session, Gate 5.4 - Cross-Farm Wind Transfer & Target-Normal Calibration
authoritative_directories.caveat: Contains a 388MB farm_data_cache.pkl not currently excluded by .gitignore - see discrepancy_log.csv D5. Uses FARM_COMMON_MAPPING, which has one questioned Farm-B column choice - see D2.

authoritative_directories.authoritative_for: RAI_CHAMPION CARE scores under care_common/care_native(_semantic) feature policies for all 3 farms (0.601/0.560/0.575), and the published-Isolation-Forest fidelity reproduction (PCA 99% variance, n=100, contamination=0.09).
authoritative_directories.caveat: The care_2d row cited in docs/checkpoints/11-care-feature-rai-integration.md is NOT backed by any artifact directory that still exists (see D1) - do not treat any 'care_2d' number as authoritative from any current directory.

authoritative_directories.authoritative_for: The original single-farm (A) and multi-farm (A/B/C) narrow-policy CARE baseline (2 signals, isolation_forest/zscore_threshold) - these three directories agree with each other and are treated as one converged result, not three competing ones (see discrepancy_log.csv D7).
authoritative_directories.produced_by: rai/eval/external/care/farm_a_runner.py (both gate51_care_multifarm.py and gate5_1_run.py call this unmodified)
authoritative_directories.owner_session: mixed - farm_a_runner.py by this session originally (Gate 2), Farm B/C extension duplicated independently by both sessions (Gate 5.1)

non_authoritative_or_stale.status: DOES NOT EXIST on disk. Referenced only by docs/checkpoints/11-care-feature-rai-integration.md's 'Files' section. Any number attributed to this script (specifically the care_2d row) cannot currently be reproduced or audited from the repository as it stands.
